issue.title: Update Bible Tab for Verse/Pericope Toggle
issue.body: The Bible tab's audio player and unit cards need to render at whichever granularity is active. With the verse/pericope toggle making the working unit a live per-user setting, both components need to re-render at the active granularity whenever the toggle changes. ## Functional Requirements ### Source Audio Player - Update the unit counter label to reflect the active mode, e.g. "Pericope 2 / 5" in pericope mode or "Verse 3 / 12" in verse mode. - In pericope mode, show verse-boundary tick marks on the waveform whenever the API provides verse timestamp data within the pericope audio. - In verse mode, show verse tick marks on the waveform whenever the API provides verse timestamp data for the active verse. - Fall back to a plain continuous scrubber, with no tick marks, whenever no subdivision timestamp data exists for the active unit, in either mode. ### Unit Cards - Render one card per pericope in pericope mode, or one card per verse in verse mode. - Set each card's title to the pericope range or verse reference; never show a numbered label like "Pericope 1". - Show a checkmark per unit indicating recorded status, green (`#16A34A`): one checkmark per verse in verse mode, one per pericope in pericope mode. - Show a distinct "partially recorded" status indicator, `li:loader-circle` in amber (`#FBBF24`), separate from the standard recorded checkmark, for a pericope where only some of its verses have been recorded. - Re-render the card list at the new granularity and re-run auto-select of the last unrecorded unit whenever the toggle changes. - Render a pericope that spans multiple chapters as a card in every chapter's Unit Card list it spans; the card is identically interactive (play, record, edit) from any of those chapters. - Attribute a cross-chapter pericope to its starting chapter only for that chapter's progress/phase status; chapters it spills into do not count it toward their own progress. #### Pericope View #### Verse View > **Note:** The "partially recorded" indicator logic overlaps with the cross-granularity playback ticket (#411) — confirm which ticket owns building the indicator itself versus the playback behavior behind it. > **Note 2:** This ticket depends on #412 (Build Source Audio Player for Bible Tab) — the live app's Bible tab has no audio player yet, so the baseline player must exist before this ticket's toggle-driven updates can be built. > **Note 3:** Whether the API currently provides sub-verse timestamp data (verse mode) or verse timestamp data within pericope audio (pericope mode) is unconfirmed for either; whichever is missing falls back to a plain scrubber until it exists. Confirm with engineering before build. > **Note 4:** Cross-chapter pericope cards require the pericope-to-chapter mapping data (from USFM) to know which chapters a given pericope spans — confirm this is available alongside the existing pericope boundary data.

comments.body:
## Engineering context

### Product intent
When drafting unit mode is Verse vs Pericope, Bible tab unit cards and the source player re-render at that granularity (counter label, optional tick marks, recorded/partial status, cross-chapter pericope cards + progress attribution).

### What exists today
- Bible tab is a flat verse list with a green/gray `AudioLines` affordance (`recordedVerseNumbers`) — not unit cards, no check / partial states.
- No pericope tables, queries, or `FluentAPI` pericope client on mobile.
- Source player baseline is #412; ticks are explicitly deferred from #412 to here.
- Mode preference: #407 (PR #434 in flight) — local per-user KV; account sync deferred.

### Ownership clarification (already partly in the ticket)
- **Build** the “partially recorded” indicator UI here.
- **#411** owns playback behavior when coverage is incomplete (play recorded verses in order, stop).
- Counter/mode switching and ticks belong here; baseline player chrome belongs in #412.

### Alignment notes
- Tick marks: fluent-api source-audio may return **verse** `verseTimestamps` (DBL). **Sub-verse** timestamps are not in the contract — fall back to a plain scrubber in verse mode until/unless that data exists (matches Note 3).
- Cross-chapter pericopes: API `GET /projects/{id}/pericopes/{bookCode}/{chapter}` returns groups with `{ chapterNumber, verseNumber }[]`, but the server currently **filters rows to the requested chapter only**, so the full multi-chapter range is not available from one call. Cross-chapter card + full-range title AC needs either an API expansion or a careful multi-chapter client merge — worth confirming with API before building that slice.
- Card titles: use pericope verse range / verse reference — never `"Pericope N"`. Status colors: recorded `#16A34A`; partial `li:loader-circle` amber `#FBBF24` — map through theme tokens where possible (`theme.colors.syncSynced` already used for recorded verses).

### Suggested approach
1. Depend on #412 player + #407 mode + mobile pericope sync into SQLite (API surface exists; mobile schema/client/sync do not yet).
2. Derive unit list from mode; auto-select last unrecorded unit on toggle change.
3. Player counter: `Verse n / m` vs `Pericope n / m`; ticks only when timestamp data exists.
4. Progress: attribute cross-chapter pericopes to **starting chapter only**.

### Dependencies
- **Blocked on:** #412, #407, mobile pericope sync (schema + `FluentAPI` + sync step).
- Soft-blocked on full-span chapter pericopes from API for honest cross-chapter AC.
- Coordinates with #411 on partial indicator vs playback.

### API / foundation gaps (do not invent in this PR)
1. **Mobile:** Sync project pericopes → SQLite (`FluentAPI.getChapterPericopes`, schema, sync, queries). Referenced from #407 Note 2; not implemented yet.
2. **fluent-api:** Chapter pericopes that touch the chapter should ideally include **all** verses in the pericope (other chapters), not only in-chapter rows — needed for cross-chapter cards / full-range titles.
3. **Optional fluent-api:** Sub-verse timestamps on source-audio if verse-mode ticks are required beyond the plain-scrubber fallback.

### Out of scope
- Settings toggle UI (#407)
- Record tab title/waveform mode (#409)
- Take labeling / 5-cap (#410)
- Stitching playback (#411)

**Blocked on:** [#438](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/438) — Sync pericope boundaries to local SQLite (data model + post-login sync).

That ticket covers schema, `FluentAPI.getChapterPericopes`, repository writes, sync step, and offline queries. Implement #438 (or land it first) before building unit cards / mode-driven rendering here — avoids stubbing pericope lists in UI hooks.

Also still depends on #412 (baseline player) and #407 (mode preference).

@Roslin22, Nightly QA checklist — #408 Bible tab Verse ↔ Pericope
PR: https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/535
Checklist generated with AI assistance.

Checklist
1. Settings → Verse: Bible tab shows verse rows (number, text, AudioLines waveform). Play source audio → playing verse gets the light-blue row highlight.
2. Settings → Pericope: loading spinner while units load (no verse-row flash). Cards show range titles (e.g. Mark 14:1–2), not “Pericope N”. Cards start collapsed; tap to expand/collapse. Expanded body: one paragraph with small superscript verse numbers. Collapsed preview: no verse numbers. Expanded: light-blue fill + primary 1px border. Collapsed: no border. Expanding does not scroll the list.
3. Toggle Verse ↔ Pericope: list re-renders and auto-selects the last not-fully-recorded unit.
4. Tap a pericope card: selection stays on Bible (does not jump to Record).
5. Source audio caption shows “Verse N / total” or “Pericope N / total”.
6. Waveform boundary ticks (optional): only if the project’s source audio has verseTimestamps (DBL/Aquifer). Many projects have none — plain scrubber is OK. When timestamps exist, confirm ticks appear.

Pass when: Verse and pericope modes match the #408 mocks for list layout, selection, recording status, and player caption. Waveform ticks only when the API provides verse timestamps.

Also from Matt’s review on the PR:
- Pericope cards with partial recording icons
- Source-audio boundary ticks when verseTimestamps exist
- Toggling Verse ↔ Pericope with an in-progress source-audio play

**Verified Results:#408**

- Verified that Unit Cards and the source audio player update correctly when switching between Verse and Pericope modes.
- Verified that one card is displayed per verse in Verse mode and one card per pericope in Pericope mode.
- Verified that recorded units show the correct checkmark and partially recorded pericopes show the partial recording indicator.
- Verified that a cross-chapter pericope is displayed in both chapters and can be played, recorded, and edited from either chapter.

**Issues Identified**

- In Pericope mode, the app does not automatically select the last unrecorded unit.
- When scrubbing the source audio in the Bible tab, playback sometimes starts again from the beginning instead of the selected position.

**Suggestion**

- While the source audio is playing, highlight the corresponding verse in the source Bible text so users can easily identify which verse is currently playing.

Since pericopes are large and not making a long list to sort through, I am not too concerned about it not selecting the last unrecorded unit in pericope mode.

I am concerned about scrubbing not working sometimes. This needs to be fixed.

@chadw-eten, @Roslin22, 

I will check it and keep you posted!
